name: sensitive-words-dfa-filter
author: stultuss
description: A trie-based sensitive-word filter for Node.js. It scans text against a keyword dictionary and masks matches, while also detecting common obfuscation tricks such as inserting spaces, symbols, digits, or letters between the characters of a keyword.

scripts.test: tsc --rootDir . --outDir .test-build --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node --target es2017 --module commonjs src/index.ts tests/WordsFilter.test.ts tests/WordsFilter-New.test.ts tests/unit.test.ts && node .test-build/tests/WordsFilter.test.js && node .test-build/tests/WordsFilter-New.test.js && node .test-build/tests/unit.test.js
